verdict.rationale: Crossmint lets a developer delegate scoped, revocable signing authority to an agent so it can transact without per-action prompts. Its agent checkouts complete one-off purchases on a user's behalf. Neither is a product feature for setting up recurring or scheduled automations that run in the background: these are developer building blocks and one-off actions, not an automation or scheduling capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Crossmint completes the checkout on your user's behalf
